crossrefs.text: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.

And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.
Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

groups.title: The royal line: Judah to David to Jesus

crossrefs.text: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.
Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now), in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.
For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
